major_cooldowns.name: Adrenaline Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it on cooldown at low combo points, spam through the Energy overcap it causes, and never delay it to line up with Bloodlust or Time Warp.

major_cooldowns.name: Roll the Bones
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Roll on cooldown while the buff is down or stuck at Stage 1, and reroll a Stage 2 only when Loaded Dice is up and Between the Eyes is ready.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1214909 is the cast id observed in current logs; the guide text links 315508 for the same ability.

major_cooldowns.name: Between the Eyes
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Fire it on cooldown at 6 or more combo points to keep its damage buff rolling; with Supercharger and Zero In, hold it once Adrenaline Rush is inside 30 seconds and send it during the Rush.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Rush
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it on cooldown like a builder: always at 2 or more targets, and on single target when you are more than 2 seconds from capping Energy or wearing the 2-piece.

major_cooldowns.name: Blade Flurry
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Keep it up whenever a second target is in cleave range, pressed at low combo points so the combo points from Deft Maneuvers are not wasted.

major_cooldowns.name: Killing Spree
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it at 6 or more combo points once your other cooldowns are down, avoid it while Supercharger is active, and cancel the channel the moment you cap Energy.

major_cooldowns.name: Keep It Rolling
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Extend a Stage 3 or better Roll the Bones; at Stage 2 use it anyway unless a Loaded Dice proc or an imminent Adrenaline Rush will hand you a better roll shortly.

major_cooldowns.name: Preparation
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it once Between the Eyes is on cooldown and Adrenaline Rush is more than 30 seconds out, or inside the last 30 seconds of the fight, to reset Adrenaline Rush, Between the Eyes, Blade Flurry, Blade Rush and Killing Spree.

major_cooldowns.name: Light's Potential
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drink it on the pull alongside your racial and on-use trinkets, and re-use it under Bloodlust, inside Adrenaline Rush, or in the last 30 seconds of the fight.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Damage potion cast id from the sampled parse; a different potion choice logs a different id.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press it into every raid-wide hit for 40% less area damage, and with Elusiveness it also cuts 20% off non-area damage.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Heal 20% of your maximum health through chip damage; the cooldown is short enough that sitting on it is pure waste.

defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Save it for magic damage, for clearing debuffs that would drag you out of melee, and for soaking anything that does not pierce immunities.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use it while facing physical melee damage; with Elusiveness it also reduces damage taken by 20%.

rules.description: Slice and Dice up for the whole fight
rules.action: Apply Slice and Dice before the pull and refresh it with a finisher before it drops; losing the 50% attack speed stalls your whole Energy engine.

rules.description: Between the Eyes at 6+ combo points
rules.action: Only fire Between the Eyes at 6 or more combo points. It is your damage-buff finisher, so dumping it low costs both the hit and the buff.

rules.description: Dispatch as your 5+ combo point finisher
rules.action: Use Dispatch as your default finisher at 5 or more combo points, 6 or more as Fatebound, and only when Between the Eyes and Killing Spree are unavailable.
Channel Killing Spree at 6 or more combo points only, and cancel it if you cap Energy during the channel.

rules.description: Pistol Shot as filler while Opportunity is up
rules.action: Build with Pistol Shot whenever Opportunity is up: spend it immediately at 6 stacks, and at 3 stacks only while you sit at 1 to 3 combo points. Fall back to Sinister Strike the rest of the time.

rules.description: Blade Flurry with a second target in range
rules.action: Keep Blade Flurry up from 2 targets upward, pressed at low combo points for the full Deft Maneuvers benefit; at 3 or more targets it doubles as a builder.
Hold Preparation until Between the Eyes is spent and on cooldown and Adrenaline Rush is more than 30 seconds away, then press it to reset both.

rules.description: Blade Rush, Between the Eyes, Killing Spree
rules.action: After the pre-pull Adrenaline Rush, Roll the Bones and Slice and Dice, open with Blade Rush, send Between the Eyes at 6+ combo points, and save Killing Spree until everything else is on cooldown.

source_summary: Outlaw runs on Adrenaline Rush and Between the Eyes: press Adrenaline Rush on cooldown at low combo points, keep Roll the Bones at Stage 2 or better, and spend Between the Eyes on cooldown at 6+ combo points to hold its damage buff, with Preparation resetting the pair once both are down. Blade Rush is used like a builder on cooldown, Blade Flurry goes up from two targets, and Killing Spree is saved for 6+ combo points once the rest of the kit is spent. Keep It Rolling extends a Stage 3 or better roll, and Slice and Dice plus Opportunity-buffed Pistol Shots carry the moment-to-moment rotation.
